variables.GITHUB_REPOSITORY: owner/name of the repository the ticket started on
variables.GITHUB_NUMBER: the issue or pull request number

variables.POSTHOG_PROJECT: the PostHog project the error is in
variables.POSTHOG_ISSUE: the id of the error tracking issue

variables.SLACK_CHANNEL: the channel the ticket started in

unheld.reason: the acknowledgement that frees a closing seat, in a pause too
a turn that ends during a pause gives its seat back; fill stays held
a person's stop must reach the Agent during a pause; it moves no work
rows only: routes an Input or queues an Assignment; the tell and the seat stay held
a policy change reaches live tickets and mandates in a pause too
starts the eval pass; a new superagent is never paused
the event that ends the hold
the event that ends the hold

superagents.name: coder
superagents.purpose: Takes asks on issues and in Slack; answers with pull requests.

account.name: account
account.description: One account of an outside service, as a superagent has seen it, and whether its person is listed to ask.

agent.name: agent
agent.description: One agent: a durable conversation that lives in its own actor, told through the outbox and acting as itself.

assignment.name: assignment
assignment.description: One stretch of a ticket's executor holding a seat: it waits, runs, ends.

attention.name: attention
attention.description: A question a person must answer, made by a report; a person's next message answers it.

correlation.name: correlation
correlation.description: A trigger seen on another thread: it adds context to a judgement and never routes.

decision.name: decision
decision.description: What the main agent decided for an eval: each item accepted, attached, stopped or ignored.

eval.name: eval
eval.description: One judgement the main agent is asked for: a thread's waiting triggers, batched.

input.name: input
input.description: One message for a ticket's executor, waiting for a seat, routed, delivered or failed.

mandate.name: mandate
mandate.description: What a ticket may do, pinned to the policy version it was accepted under.

outgoing-message.name: outgoing-message
outgoing-message.description: One reply to a person, kept until it is sent: in order, the head of its conversation first.

policy.name: policy
policy.description: A superagent's rules: who may ask, how, and what it may accept. One current version, every save kept.

prompt-set.name: prompt-set
prompt-set.description: What a team writes into its agents' prompts: sections, skills and overrides. One current version, every save kept.

proposal.name: proposal
proposal.description: What a main agent would change in a superagent's configuration, and why, waiting for a person.

report.name: report
report.description: How the executor says a ticket stands. Its state is its kind.

settings.name: settings
settings.description: The app's settings: execution variables and blocked commands. One current version, every save kept.

source.name: source
source.description: One connection of a superagent to an outside service, with the place it has read to.

subscription.name: subscription
subscription.description: A ticket following one thread: its own, one attached, one for context, or one it is bound to.

superagent.name: superagent
superagent.description: One always-on agent, stored as data.

thread.name: thread
thread.description: An issue, a pull request or a Slack thread a superagent listens to. One eval runs on it at a time.

ticket.name: ticket
ticket.description: One piece of work a superagent was allowed to do, with the executor that works it.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.description: One event that came in from a connection. Never changed once stored.

account.list.name: account.list
account.list.description: Let an account ask: its person's words may then start work.

account.seen.name: account.seen
account.seen.description: Record an account an event came from: a new one is seen, a known one keeps its state.

account.sync.name: account.sync
account.sync.description: List the accounts a connection's own roster names: a repository's collaborators, a user group.

agent.close.name: agent.close
agent.close.description: Stop an agent's turn for one Assignment and say so: the seat that held it is then free.

agent.open.name: agent.open
agent.open.description: Make an agent of one kind, about one thing: any operation allowed to create one makes it.

agent.tell.name: agent.tell
agent.tell.description: Give an agent one input, steering it when it is busy. Only an outbox hop calls it, with the delivering event's id as the request id.

assignment.cancelled.name: assignment.cancelled
assignment.cancelled.description: End a pending Assignment that was never seated or told.

assignment.interrupted.name: assignment.interrupted
assignment.interrupted.description: Close a running Assignment: a stop, a retire or a reap. It keeps its seat until the Agent says it closed.

assignment.promoted.name: assignment.promoted
assignment.promoted.description: A person's Input on a pending Assignment moves it up: its reason becomes a person's.

assignment.queued.name: assignment.queued
assignment.queued.description: Queue an Assignment for a ticket's executor: an accept, an Input or a resume. It names the Input that woke it.

assignment.started.name: assignment.started
assignment.started.description: Give a waiting Assignment a seat, if one is free for it.

assignment.turn-ended.name: assignment.turn-ended
assignment.turn-ended.description: The Agent idled on this Assignment or closed it: it ends, and its seat is free.

assignment.waiting.name: assignment.waiting
assignment.waiting.description: List assignments, oldest first, 255 to a page, filtered by superagent.

decision.dismiss.name: decision.dismiss
decision.dismiss.description: Set aside a decision a person disagrees with.

decision.route.name: decision.route
decision.route.description: Route an eval's items: one to twenty, each accept, attach, stop or ignore. An explicit request makes its ticket in every mode; in observe an inferred accept is only recorded as one it would make.

eval.context.name: eval.context
eval.context.description: Read what a judgement needs: the thread's history and what else it touches.

eval.decide.name: eval.decide
eval.decide.description: Record one judgement per enabled rule.

eval.delivered.name: eval.delivered
eval.delivered.description: Start an eval's clock when it is told to the main agent: a held hop, so a pause never starts it.

eval.due.name: eval.due
eval.due.description: One pass of the eval clock: batch each thread's waiting triggers into an eval, and expire the ones that ran out of time. Not armed again while paused.

eval.expire.name: eval.expire
eval.expire.description: Give up on an eval that ran out of time: it is unavailable, and its triggers wait for another.

eval.read.name: eval.read
eval.read.description: Read one page of a thread, through its connection.

eval.start.name: eval.start
eval.start.description: Make an eval for one thread's waiting triggers.

input.delivery-failed.name: input.delivery-failed
input.delivery-failed.description: The outbox gave up telling the executor.

input.requeue.name: input.requeue
input.requeue.description: Put a refused or failed Input back to waiting, after a short wait that grows with each refusal.

input.route.name: input.route
input.route.description: Send a waiting Input to its running executor, or queue the Assignment that will start one.

input.store.name: input.store
input.store.description: Store a message for a ticket's executor: a person's, or a followed thread's trigger.

mandate.revalidate.name: mandate.revalidate
mandate.revalidate.description: Check a ticket's mandate against the policy as it is now, before the ticket resumes.

outgoing-message.reply.name: outgoing-message.reply
outgoing-message.reply.description: Queue a reply: by purpose, in order within its conversation. Only the head of a conversation has an outbox row.

outgoing-message.retry.name: outgoing-message.retry
outgoing-message.retry.description: Queue a failed reply again, once its wait has passed.

outgoing-message.send.name: outgoing-message.send
outgoing-message.send.description: Send a conversation's head through its connection. A failed call is counted and queued again; the outbox always sees a success.

outgoing-message.withdraw.name: outgoing-message.withdraw
outgoing-message.withdraw.description: Drop a ticket's pending replies: it ended, or its superagent retired.

policy.get.name: policy.get
policy.get.description: Read the policy: the current version, or the one named.

policy.history.name: policy.history
policy.history.description: Every saved version, newest first, each row its number, when, by whom, and the one it was made from.

policy.restore.name: policy.restore
policy.restore.description: Save an earlier version again, as a new one.

policy.save.name: policy.save
policy.save.description: Save a new version of the policy. A save made from an older version is refused, with the current one.

policy.sync.name: policy.sync
policy.sync.description: List the accounts a connection's roster names.

prompt-set.compose.name: prompt-set.compose
prompt-set.compose.description: Make the prompt for one agent's model request, from the current version.

prompt-set.history.name: prompt-set.history
prompt-set.history.description: Every saved version, newest first, each row its number, when, by whom, and the one it was made from.

prompt-set.preview.name: prompt-set.preview
prompt-set.preview.description: Show the prompt an agent of one kind would get, with a draft applied.

prompt-set.save.name: prompt-set.save
prompt-set.save.description: Save a new version of the prompts. A save made from an older version is refused, with the current one.

proposal.approve.name: proposal.approve
proposal.approve.description: Apply a proposal. Only a signed-in person, through a session: text that reached a model is never an approval.

proposal.propose.name: proposal.propose
proposal.propose.description: Record what a main agent would change, and why: nothing changes until a person approves it.

proposal.waiting.name: proposal.waiting
proposal.waiting.description: List proposals, oldest first, 25 to a page, filtered by superagent.

settings.save.name: settings.save
settings.save.description: Save a new version of the settings. A save made from an older version is refused, with the current one. A main agent may only propose it.

source.disable.name: source.disable
source.disable.description: Stop listening on a connection; its triggers already recorded stay.

source.position-advanced.name: source.position-advanced
source.position-advanced.description: Record how far a connection has read, after a poll.

source.problem.name: source.problem
source.problem.description: Say a connection has failed three polls in a row: it shows as a problem until a poll succeeds.

source.save.name: source.save
source.save.description: Save a connection: its kind and its configuration.

superagent.boot.name: superagent.boot
superagent.boot.description: The world's once-a-minute backstop: arm each live superagent's eval pass and sweeps that a restart lost.

superagent.create.name: superagent.create
superagent.create.description: Make a superagent, with its main agent, observing.

superagent.fill.name: superagent.fill
superagent.fill.description: Start waiting Assignments, in line, while seats are free. Does nothing while paused.

superagent.go-live.name: superagent.go-live
superagent.go-live.description: Let a superagent act: a person, after reading what it would have accepted.

superagent.health.name: superagent.health
superagent.health.description: Read one superagent by its id: name, state, pausedAt.

superagent.pause.name: superagent.pause
superagent.pause.description: Hold evals, launches, deliveries and replies; sources keep recording. Only a person, through a session.

superagent.reap.name: superagent.reap
superagent.reap.description: Close the running Assignments whose executor is idle, so their seats come back once the Agent has said it closed.

superagent.resume.name: superagent.resume
superagent.resume.description: Let held work go, and move every eval's deadline later by the pause's length. Only a person, through a session.

superagent.retire.name: superagent.retire
superagent.retire.description: Close a superagent's connections and agents.

superagent.update.name: superagent.update
superagent.update.description: Save a superagent's configuration as a new version; a stale save is refused.

thread.bind.name: thread.bind
thread.bind.description: Make the thread an event belongs to, once, for this superagent.

thread.closed.name: thread.closed
thread.closed.description: Say a thread closed: a merged pull request, a closed issue.

thread.follow.name: thread.follow
thread.follow.description: The executor follows a thread: its next messages go straight to it, with no eval.

thread.unrelated.name: thread.unrelated
thread.unrelated.description: The executor says a thread has nothing to do with its ticket.

thread.unsubscribe.name: thread.unsubscribe
thread.unsubscribe.description: Stop a ticket following a thread: a person's call, or the main agent's.

ticket.accept.name: ticket.accept
ticket.accept.description: Make a ticket from an accepted trigger: its mandate, subscription, first assignment and first input, in one commit.

ticket.ack.name: ticket.ack
ticket.ack.description: The executor acknowledges the message it was woken by, once, in one short reply.

ticket.attach.name: ticket.attach
ticket.attach.description: Attach another thread to a ticket.

ticket.end.name: ticket.end
ticket.end.description: End a ticket: the reported work is ready, its threads are closed, or the playbook says so. Its executor stays, idle.

ticket.note.name: ticket.note
ticket.note.description: Write a note on a ticket that does not wake its executor.

ticket.policy-changed.name: ticket.policy-changed
ticket.policy-changed.description: Tell the live tickets the policy changed under them.

ticket.report.name: ticket.report
ticket.report.description: The executor says how the work stands: progress, waiting, ready, blocked, failed or dropped.

ticket.request-status.name: ticket.request-status
ticket.request-status.description: Ask a ticket's executor where it stands; a person's request may use the seat kept for a person.

ticket.resume.name: ticket.resume
ticket.resume.description: Wake an ended ticket on a person's message, after its mandate is revalidated: the same executor, with its memory.

ticket.stage.name: ticket.stage
ticket.stage.description: Read one ticket by its id: superagent, title, state.

ticket.stop.name: ticket.stop
ticket.stop.description: Stop a ticket: its mandate is withdrawn and its executor's turn closed.

ticket.waiting.name: ticket.waiting
ticket.waiting.description: List tickets, newest first, 50 to a page, filtered by superagent, stage.

trigger.handback.name: trigger.handback
trigger.handback.description: The executor hands a trigger back: it was not its to answer.

trigger.receive.name: trigger.receive
trigger.receive.description: Store one event a connection brought, once: a second delivery of the same event is a duplicate, and one the policy filters is not kept.

trigger.reevaluate.name: trigger.reevaluate
trigger.reevaluate.description: Ask the main agent to judge a trigger again.

trigger.requeue.name: trigger.requeue
trigger.requeue.description: Put a trigger back for evaluation.

test.name: test
test.runs: a fresh world for each pull request

standIn.what: a bare git repository served by git http-backend, with a small server for GitHub's REST API over it
a small server over project 1 and three error tracking issues that answers PostHog's REST API as PostHog does
a small server over channel C024BE91L that answers Slack's Web API as Slack does
